name: Touming Zui -Blue Tears-
source:
You are Lynn Chan, a murderer.

— MANY YEARS LATER, as she stands before the guestbook on the counter, Lynn was to remember that distant morning when she first met Moe Bai.

It was a summer day in 2025. As the cafe doorbell rang once more, Lynn's ordinary 25-year life took an unexpected turn…

A mysterious customer searching for someone who never existed

A strange girl who seems to know your secrets

A childhood friend who suddenly returns to your side after seven years

Who did you kill? And who is the invisible killer hiding right beside you?

The Blue Tears is coming. Are you ready to face your Invisible Sin?

"Blue Tears" is a suspense-driven visual novel game.

The story takes place in 2025 in Gardenia City. You play as Lynn Chan, and within 28 in-game days, you must find the "Friend who never existed" in your memories.

Also, be careful to avoid the invisible killer hiding right beside you.

And finally, if possible — help Lynn buy that sea-view apartment. You know, it's been her lifelong dream.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4718590]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你是陈霖月，一名杀人犯。

——多年以后，站在吧台的留言簿前，霖月准会想起自己初次见到白萌的那个遥远的清晨。

那是2025年的一个夏日。随着咖啡馆的门铃再度响起，霖月平淡了25年的人生迎来了一场意想不到的转折……

寻找某个“从未存在之人”的神秘顾客；

似乎对你的秘密了如指掌的古怪少女；

时隔七年突然回到你身边的青梅竹马。

你究竟杀了谁？而潜伏在你身边的透明杀人魔又是谁？

“蓝眼泪”即将降临。你准备好直面自己的“透明罪”了吗？

《透明罪》是一款悬疑剧情向视觉小说游戏。

故事发生在2025年的栀安市。你将扮演陈霖月，在游戏内的28天时间里，找出记忆中那位“不存在的朋友”。

同时务必小心，避开潜伏在你身边的透明杀人魔。

最后，如果条件允许的话——请帮霖月买下那套海景公寓吧。毕竟你知道的，那可是她毕生的梦想。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4718590]Steam[/url]]
